summary: The Upstage x AWS AI Initiative provides eligible educational and public-interest organizations — schools, hospitals, and nonprofits — with free access to Solar Pro (LLM) and Document Parse for up to one year. Applications go through the 'Get free access' link on the Upstage pricing page.
claim_steps: Open the Upstage pricing page and find the 'AI support program for educational and public interest organizations' section.
Click 'Get free access' and submit the application for your school, hospital, or nonprofit.
On approval, use Solar Pro (LLM) and Document Parse free for up to one year.
